acceptanceCriteria: core/no-threshold-lowering flags a lowered SPEC 4.10.4 coverage-threshold key across the L4 range
a missing custom pack fails the load CDX-E203; a failing custom pack loads inert and core/custom-pack-selftest blocks at L4
the l34 umbrella reports no silent verify-tdd-range row
diagnosis: Reproduce: the l34 firing umbrella lists core/no-threshold-lowering and core/custom-pack-selftest as silent on the ci verify range probe. Root cause: RANGE_JUDGES in packs/enforcers/range-config-judges.ts has no entry for either rule, so at L4 each judges fixture marker reports only; and cli/evaluate.ts loadEvalEnforcers skips every non-builtin pack id, so a configured custom pack is never loaded, self-tested or judged (a missing one is not CDX-E203 either). Both waited on SPEC, which PR #233 settled in SPEC 4.10.4 (threshold keys) and 4.2.1 step 3 / 4.4.4 / 4.4.8 EC-4 (failing custom pack inert, L4 blocks).
